## 2. Master index structure (user-locked, front position)

Top level **GS-wise** (GS-1 → GS-2 → GS-3 → GS-4), then **subject-wise** inside each paper, then `section_group` → `subtopic` → card links. Anchors: `#ix-gs1…#ix-gs4` + `#ix-master`.

**v3 layout:** `.ix-body` flows in **2 columns**; each subtopic is one compact `.ix-line` row — `subtopic name (clickable → #st-N) — Title · Title · … (each clickable → #card-<ID>)`. Sheets are auto-paginated by a browser-calibrated height budget (`BUDGET=2080`px stacked content ≈ 950px per column) so every index sheet is one clean A4 page; continuation sheets carry an `ix-hint` label (`CONTENTS · GS-3 · ENVIRONMENT · CONTINUED`).

Counts (script-verified): 551 card links · 209 clickable subtopic names · 48 clickable section rows · 14 clickable subject rows · 4 clickable paper rows · 0 count badges.
